content.short: Take back the control of your finances through a simple decentralized, trustless RealFi and DeFi ecosystem.
content.description: Millions of people in Africa are unable to control their financial health due to financial exclusion, unfriendly legacy banking policies and products, bad government policies and high inflation rates. Thrift Finance - Take back the control of your finances through a decentralized, trustless RealFi and DeFi ecosystem. Thrift Finance is a suite of products for decentralized, trustless, smart-contract powered thrift savings, micro finance, RealFi and DeFi systems, governed, maintained and upgraded by Thrift token holders to create a more accessible and efficient.
